dedupe_keys.name: 3d building models of poland lod1 and lod2 gugik modele 3d budynkow

description: GUGiK, Poland's national mapping agency, publishes 3D models of a large share of the buildings in the BDOT10k topographic database, compiled from BDOT10k 2D building outlines (class BUBD_A), airborne laser scanning points classed as building (4 or 12 points per m2) and a 1 m digital terrain model. LoD2 models in CityGML 2.0 were produced for 236 counties in ten voivodeships under the CAPAP (Centre for Spatial Analysis of Public Administration) project. LoD1 models, prisms with the building outline as base and the median lidar height, cover the whole country in editions for 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024; an April 2025 update refreshed LoD1 models for the Lublin, Podlaskie, Warmian-Masurian and Świętokrzyskie voivodeships and added a measuredHeight attribute. Files are downloaded per area from the Geoportal 'Modele 3D budynków' layer or viewed through WMS. Coverage: Poland (LoD1 nationwide, LoD2 partial). Access: free. Licence: CC0 1.0 on dane.gov.pl. Caveats: height is approximate, LoD2 does not cover the whole country, and editions differ by source vintage. Simulation uses: national building exposure, solar and energy models, and 3D city analysis in Poland. Related records: EUBUCCO and the DBSM R2025.
